fact: The RBZ capped POS charges at 1.5% of transaction value for local and international cards from 1 April 2026, with no minimum fee and a maximum of US$20.

The RBZ directed all banks and deposit-taking microfinance institutions to cap cash withdrawal fees at 2% and POS charges at 1.5%, and to remove balance inquiry fees on banking and mobile banking platforms, by 31 March 2026.
The RBZ governor says the central bank has continued to receive complaints from the banking public about the high cost of banking.

The Consumer Protection Act Chapter 14.44 Section 51(h) gives consumers the right to choose their mode of payment, and the Finance Act 2018 amendment to Chapter 24:24 requires businesses to offer electronic payment, per the Consumer Protection Commission.
